columns.t_s: seconds since the start of the trend
columns.bus_hz: bus frequency transducer on the 400 kV busbar VT, Hz
columns.shaft_rpm: turbine shaft speed, rpm (setup.shaft_rpm_from says whose record)
columns.injected_mhz: frequency deviation the test set sends, mHz
columns.gen_mw_1: generator MW transducer 1 (generator VT and CT)
columns.gen_mw_2: generator MW transducer 2 (generator VT and CT)
columns.exhaust_limit_degc: exhaust temperature control limit at the present conditions, degC
columns.meter_mwh: revenue meter energy register, MWh (own metering VT and CT, class 0.2S; setup.revenue_meter says where)
